lastTask: Implement Track D4 diversity floor and latent reservoir

projectState.summary: Track D4 is implemented on codex/byte-d4-diversity-reservoir and ready for Claude review. It adds optional default-off diversity selection, a reserved latent reservoir status/audit path, pitch-content interestingness plus prosody-score novelty metrics, and deterministic reserved-parent development without touching audio/model/transport. Default-off evolution remains D3-identical; enabled runs preserve the top fitness elite, add distance-filtered diverse elites, reserve high-interest/low-fitness candidates, and breed a deterministic fraction of reserved parents. Validation: build, smoke 64/64, db:smoke, and diff-check are green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories. Observed D4 seed 4242 top fitness 0.6317 -> 0.7945 -> 0.7945 -> 0.8199 with reservoir size 2; seed 515151 top fitness 0.7718 -> 0.8067 -> 0.8222 with reservoir size 2. Carry forward branch-scoped candidate ids before parallel populations and shared/recomputed B2 operators before trusted/untrusted provenance.
